title: Farewell Meet Celebrating the Graduating Batch
excerpt: Students, faculty, and staff gathered to celebrate and honor the graduating batch with a special farewell program.
author: GEC Communications
body: Glory Education Center organized a heartfelt Farewell Meet to honor the graduating students. The program included worship, speeches, cultural presentations, and words of encouragement from faculty members. It was a memorable occasion celebrating the students' academic journey while wishing them God's guidance and blessings as they move forward in their ministries and careers.

title: Annual Summer Program Successfully Conducted
excerpt: The Summer Program brought together participants for a season of learning, fellowship, and spiritual growth.
author: GEC Events Team
body: The Annual Summer Program provided participants with opportunities for biblical learning, practical workshops, worship sessions, and community fellowship. Students and guests actively engaged in the various activities designed to encourage spiritual development, leadership, and personal growth throughout the program.

title: Annual Sports Meet Promotes Teamwork and Fellowship
excerpt: Students participated enthusiastically in various sporting events, encouraging healthy competition and unity.
author: Sports Committee
body: The Annual Sports Meet featured a variety of indoor and outdoor games with enthusiastic participation from students and faculty. The event emphasized teamwork, discipline, sportsmanship, and fellowship while providing an enjoyable break from academic activities. Winners were recognized during the closing ceremony.

title: Freshers' Meet Welcomes New Students
excerpt: New students were warmly welcomed into the GEC community through an orientation and fellowship program.
author: Student Affairs Office
body: Glory Education Center warmly welcomed its new students through the annual Freshers' Meet. The event introduced students to campus life, faculty members, academic programs, and fellow classmates. Interactive activities, fellowship, and orientation sessions helped students begin their journey with confidence and a sense of belonging.
